prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original game sprite atlas, transparent PNG, 4 columns by 2 rows, eight evenly sized cells, no visible grid. Wide 2:1 landscape. These are environment props for a polished family skiing game.

Visual world: beautifully crafted miniature paper-and-clay, matte tactile surfaces, clean rounded low-poly volumes, fine layered paper edges, restrained paper fibers, warm friendly illustration. Match an established game-cover series featuring miniature pine forests, powder snow, cream mountain landscapes, warm ochre and pine-teal materials. High finish and legible silhouettes, authentic art rather than flat triangular symbols.

Arrange EXACTLY these eight isolated objects, in reading order, centered separately in the eight equal cells:
Top row: 1 a tall elegant pine tree with layered deep pine-green branches and generous soft snow caps; 2 a broader rounded spruce with alternating green branch layers and cream snow; 3 a slender young fir with a gently asymmetric crown and snow tips; 4 a low softly rounded gray rock partly buried in thick white snow.
Bottom row: 5 a compact cluster of three small snow-laden pine trees as one prop; 6 a low fallen wooden log with an inviting rounded shape and a snow cap; 7 one small Alpine wooden cabin with a steep snow roof and a warmly lit amber window, no writing; 8 a finish-line wooden arch with two posts, a simple rounded lintel and a small unlettered cream fabric banner, no lettering, no symbols.

All eight objects have the same gently elevated front three-quarter perspective, soft upper-left studio daylight and subtle compact contact shadows. They should feel like physical miniature objects from one art collection. Each object stays fully within its own cell with at least 12 percent transparent padding on every side; no tree branch, shadow or arch crosses into another cell. Their bases sit on the same baseline within each cell. Preserve small real gaps between branches with true alpha.

Background MUST be fully transparent alpha, no painted background, no checkerboard, no floor plane, no outer border, no grid. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermarks, UI, people, faces, cameras or devices. Do not include mountains or a complete scene. Crisp production game art with enough detail for close foreground objects.
input_media: No household material or real identifiable person was provided.
